notes.title: Out of Early Access
notes.content:
[h1]Utopia v1.09.1212 released! [/h1]
Today Utopia is out of early access stage and released!

Bugs fixed, gameplay rebalanced, achievements recalculated, models repainted, sounds improved and many ,many small and hidden elements changed, but game is completed now. 
[u]Big thanks for all who help me complete and make this game better![/u]

P.S. In plans : making small ingame help system, for pointing players to best practices and hidden game mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35601811/48d7e1f714b1618152cabf0af2c13842a1b140af.gif[/img]
